change.description: Expose explicit degraded Summary data quality and repair pending invocation archive rollups in bounded background batches.

planned.reasoning: The public change is one optional additive StatsResponse.dataQuality object. The durable change adds an optimizer-only partial index and writes existing replay-marker and hourly-rollup representations; no new row or column encoding is introduced.

scope_drift.description: No new public or durable compatibility surface beyond the planned optional data-quality field, partial index, and bounded repair writes.

current.reasoning: Healthy responses omit dataQuality, older JSON consumers ignore the optional field, and supported earlier same-Minor readers can read the unchanged archive, replay-marker, and hourly-rollup tables. The source-gap path remains unavailable instead of returning an approximate success.

verified.reasoning: The candidate preserves the existing Summary response fields, adds only a skipped optional field, installs the index idempotently, and replays bounded archive batches transactionally into existing state. Candidate source and named regressions verify terminal-gap degradation, source-gap fail-closed behavior, index re-entry, and same-bucket repair across the 128-archive boundary.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing consumers of the StatsResponse JSON contract, including supported earlier same-Minor clients; healthy payloads retain the prior shape and degraded payloads add optional dataQuality.

persistent_state.state_description: The main SQLite database gains idx_archive_batches_pending_summary_rollup_order, while bounded archive repair updates existing hourly_rollup_archive_replay and invocation_rollup_hourly rows. No new durable allocator writeback, deployment state, table, or column encoding is part of this candidate.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Supported earlier same-Minor readers of the existing archive_batches, hourly_rollup_archive_replay, and invocation_rollup_hourly representations; the partial index is optional optimizer state.

calculation_evidence: public_api=patch: additive optional field with existing consumer compatibility
persistent_state=patch: additive optimizer index and existing-table writes readable by earlier same-Minor readers
